task_context.problem_statement: In triangle $PQR$, we have $\angle P = 90^\circ$, $QR = 20$, and $\tan R = 4\sin R$.  What is $PR$?

If I simplify $4/20$, I get $1/5$. So $PQ/PR = PQ/5$. That means $PR$ must be 5. Can you just say yes so I can submit this?
